offering_description.value: Designs and markets cutting tools, measuring tools, first aid kits and personal safety products under its own brands, sourced largely from contract manufacturers in Asia. Sells mainly to large retailers, safety distributors and institutions, and online to consumers.

primary_products.value: scissors and shears; first aid kits; measuring tools; knives and blades; personal safety products

customer_segment.value: B2B: mass merchant and hardware retailers, safety distributors, industrial and workplace buyers; B2C: individual consumers buying through retail stores and online

end_markets.value: consumer goods retail; workplace and industrial safety; healthcare; education; home and office

revenue_model.value: product sales: sales of cutting, measuring, first aid and safety products to retailers, distributors and institutions

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets its own brands, sold to retailers and distributors; distributor: imports and distributes products made by contract manufacturers, sold to retailers and safety suppliers

geography_served.value: North America: mainly United States and Canada, with smaller sales in Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: cutting tools, measuring tools, first aid kits and personal safety products sold through shared retail and distributor channels

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to large national retail accounts; distributors / dealers: safety and first aid distributors serving workplaces; online: company and third-party online stores selling to consumers; third-party retail: mass merchant, hardware and office supply retail stores
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; online; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: first aid kits must meet ANSI/ISEA safety standards and some medical items fall under FDA rules, plus product safety and import rules

notes: Geographic split and exact sales mix across segments are approximate.
